data.name: MioTech
data.description: MioTech is a Hong Kong/Shanghai-based AI-powered ESG and sustainability data software company whose carbon asset team has expanded into CDR project development. Its Nian'da Biochar Facility in Nanjing became the first Chinese project to issue CORCs under the Puro.earth Standard in May 2025, generating 330 CORCs in its first crediting period with plans to scale to 4,500 CORCs/year by 2026-2027. The company also announced a target of 50,000 tons of CDR credits by 2027 across biochar, geological storage, carbonated materials and enhanced weathering.
